messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Users must repeatedly click Open and Save to view claim details, leading to frustration.
  quote: Tasks: click "Open"... Claim details: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: Users get frustrated because saving claim details requires multiple clicks.
  quote: click "Details" ... click "Save", rage x3
- problem: Clicking Next then trying to go to Overview results in a dead end.
  quote: Claims: click "Next"...Claims: click "Overview", dead x1
- problem: The user repeatedly encounters errors when trying to save changes.
  quote: Tasks: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The "Link to existing claim" button is broken, stopping users from linking a claim.
  quote: Claims: click "Link to existing claim", dead x1 ... Claims: click "Next"
- problem: The 'Link to existing claim' button does not work and leads to a dead link.
  quote: Claims: click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
- problem: The user cannot proceed because the link to an existing claim is non‑functional.
  quote: click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
- problem: The user must click multiple buttons, leading to frustration.
  quote: Tasks: click "Details" ... click "Save", rage x3
